says: The live instance as components and connections. It names no place on any screen. A snapshot: the site fetches nothing, so this file is what was seen on the day it says, and it changes only when it is written again. seen: connector = checked through a connector that day; session = the brain doing the checking; repo = written in a repository, not checked live. Names are generic: no addresses, ports, ids, keys or people's details.

seen.connector: checked live through a connector on the day
seen.session: the brain that wrote this snapshot
seen.repo: in a repository, not checked live
